Zero to one, then further
text: I took the Tata Neu marketplace from nothing to 1M users within three months of its pilot launch. At LiteFarm the user base has grown 54% over two years, including 31% in eleven months, across 160+ countries and with no paid marketing.

title: Judgment under scarcity
text: When resources are tight, the hard part is deciding what not to build. At Locus I turned enterprise client feedback into changes to a last-mile routing algorithm. For a food-delivery client, factoring in preparation time took rider assignment from 47% to 92%. For a Canadian client, I made the case for dark-store hubs over a single warehouse, and its delivery times fell from 90 to 45 minutes in the pilot.

title: Making many sides agree
text: Almost every role I have had meant getting people who do not report to each other, and do not want the same things, to move the same way: researchers, farmers and open-source developers at LiteFarm; legacy brands and super-app goals at Tata Neu.

title: Leading people
text: I have managed my teams directly across my last three roles, including a global remote team of nine at LiteFarm. I treat mentoring and team cohesion as part of the job.

title: Seeing start-ups from the other side
text: At TBDC, a Government of Canada-designated incubator under the Startup Visa Program, I led a team of three evaluating international founders and made go or no-go calls before they reached an expert panel. I also built market entry strategies, go-to-market roadmaps and pitch decks for 10+ early-stage founders.
